main samples startup price, submits 18 opening limits on each side at predefined distances, prints outstanding orders and returns. No fill-driven management, closing direction, unwind schedule or repeated rebalance is defined.

The script waits for a manual command and then sends coordinated opposite orders according to account inventory and operator inputs. The code contains no market signal, no economic position objective and no strategy-owned cost basis.

The one startup method prepares 38 buy limits and 36 sell limits with fixed price ratios and sizes, logs outstanding orders and returns. The executable contains no position or fill-aware lifecycle for handling those ladders.

main waits for initial book availability of an operator-selected product, submits one buy ladder through the asynchronous order wrapper, and polls pending orders. It exits when orders disappear. There is no sell, liquidation or exit rule.
